components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary brass action button used for the main call to action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e9b949; color: #0b1426; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f3c963; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral slate action button for secondary controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #182a4a; color: #eef2f9; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(182, 204, 240, 0.15); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(233, 185, 73, 0.36); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Ledger Input
components.description: Recessed navy input field with brass focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0d182c; color: #eef2f9; padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(182, 204, 240, 0.15); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #e9b949; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(233, 185, 73, 0.18); }

components.name: Slip Card
components.description: Primary ledger container with 18px radius and soft offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-slip-card { background: #12203a; color: #eef2f9; padding: 22px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(182, 204, 240, 0.15); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(3, 8, 18, 0.36); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Capsule badge for currency, rollover, and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(233, 185, 73, 0.15); color: #e9b949; border: 1px solid rgba(233, 185, 73, 0.35); }

narrative.overview: Purslip is a private household ledger built around the tactile anatomy of its brand mark: a deep ink-navy leather wallet (#0a1324), crisp porcelain paper slips (#eef1f6), and a stack of warm brass coins (#e9b949).
keyCharacteristics: Tactile material contrast between dark navy leather grounds and high-contrast porcelain/slate slips.
Brass coin accent reserved strictly for the primary action and active wayfinding.
Self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque for expressive headings paired with Geist tabular numerals for every currency amount.
Zero horizontal scroll across all viewports, with responsive drawer navigation and contained table scrollers.

rules.name: The Brass Coin Rule
rules.body: Minted Brass (#e9b949) is reserved for the single most important action in a view and active wayfinding.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every currency amount, date, percentage, and table cell uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry an uppercase kicker or eyebrow label above them.

dos: Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (.num) on every balance, transaction amount, budget figure, and date.
Do use the shared SVG icon sprite (views/partials/icons.ejs) for all navigation, action, and status icons.
Do keep all scripts external (script-src 'self') and pass chart data via <script type="application/json">.
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't use Unicode symbols or emoji in place of drawn SVG icons.
Don't use thick colored border-left or border-right stripes on cards or alerts.
